Observed on open [PR56](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-lint/pull/56), head `8805e866f7a55e1ac48f8b7ab9ab7979fca593e0`, rechecked current on 2026-11-03 at 20:05 UTC. The PR upgrades development SDK 10.28 →10.30 without changing repair implementation or tests.

## Hosted evidence
[Node 22](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-lint/actions/runs/41706993031/job/126164822295) and [Node 26](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-lint/actions/runs/41706993031/job/126164823666) each report 189 tests, 187 passed, 2 failed:
- [repair-model.test.ts 58](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-lint/blob/8805e866f7a55e1ac48f8b7ab9ab7979fca593e0/test/repair-model.test.ts#L58): sequence 0 fails deep equality after JSON round-trip because the SDK receipt contains optional `undefined` author_source/source_kind/note properties that JSON omits.
- [repairs.test.ts 49](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-lint/blob/8805e866f7a55e1ac48f8b7ab9ab7979fca593e0/test/repairs.test.ts#L49): repeating an unchanged revision-bound preview fails equality because `validation.records[].after.metadata.updated_at` differs between fresh staged validations.

## Cause and goal
[buildRepairPreview](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-lint/blob/8805e866f7a55e1ac48f8b7ab9ab7979fca593e0/src/repairs.ts#L177) forwards the entire `previewItemMutations` validation result into its public receipt. The host's [staged-record API addition](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/1598) means that result now includes normalized staged records, not just the earlier validation summary.

The closed [authoring-repair feature](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-lint/blob/8805e866f7a55e1ac48f8b7ab9ab7979fca593e0/.agents/pm/features/pm-lint-authoring-repair-previews.toon) records SDK/JSON/TOON replay and 500-sequence evidence. The tests explicitly require serializable round-trip equality and unchanged-revision receipt equality. Actual newly forwarded optional properties and staged timestamps violate those existing comparisons. Stable plan identity and a fresh validation payload need an explicit compatibility contract rather than silently treating the candidate as certified.

## Independent bounded check
Executed the exact current `buildRepairPreview` body under Node 24.22.1 with wholly synthetic SDK dependencies and two synthetic staged validation results. Revision, plan_key and repair patch stayed identical, while the different staged timestamp and optional undefined field were forwarded unchanged. This isolates the forwarding behavior; it is not a real SDK integration rerun. The hosted Node 22/26 jobs provide the real dependency evidence.

## Acceptance and limits
Define which receipt fields are stable replay identity and which are freshly staged validation evidence, preserving the host's native semantics. Ensure SDK/JSON/TOON consumers have an explicit comparable representation for optional fields, and update implementation/tests consistently with that documented contract. Keep stale-revision refusal, zero source-byte changes, independent SDK readback, native metadata preservation and all 500 sequences at unchanged coverage thresholds. Rerun Node 22/26 and packed acceptance on the final head.

This report does not establish source tracker mutation, an invalid mechanical patch or a core staged-record defect. It establishes two current upgrade acceptance failures and their receipt-shape cause. All 56 all-status GitHub issues/PRs, current PR56 discussion and all current canonical tracker records were checked. The closed repair feature supplies the goal; no existing record owns these SDK 10.30 compatibility failures. No installs, provider requests or external mutations were performed during the independent check.
SDK 2026.10.30 upgrade breaks repair-preview transport and replay equality
